newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ shares close easier but off lows in heavy trade.
newsitem.headline: NZ shares close easier but off lows in heavy trade.

text.p: * NZ shares close a touch weaker on heavy turnover
* Lion Nathan ends on year high as takeover rumours persist
* Market seen building new base before testing higher
Price movements at close
LAST CHG * NZSE40 cap index -3.53 at 2,571.98
141 +1 * NZSC cap index +17.88 at 5,273.88
350 -4 * NZMC cap index +3.78 at 2,013.80
400 +3 * Volume NZ$91 million. Futures -14 at 1,305
785 -3 * Other movers - +10 +10
New Zealand share prices closed a touch easier on Thursday but off their intraday lows as the market consolidated after a record-setting rally earlier in the week.
The NZSE-40 Capital Index ended the session 3.53 points weaker at 2,571.88 on heavy turnover worth NZ$91 million.
"I think it will just continue to consolidate, it's got to build a base at these levels before it can go much higher," said Sean Vaughan at County Natwest.
Brokers reported good two-way business in leading stocks.
Lion Nathan closed on its year high of $4.00 as takeover rumours continued to circulate the market, but brokers said it was an old story with little substance.
"When the stock gets up to these higher prices, these sorts of things get trotted out again. I don't know of any legitimate stories with regard to corporate deals," Vaughan said.
"The rumour is being bought at the moment -- we haven't seen the selling of the fact yet."
He noted that the brewer had increased its market share in Australia and was also a beneficiary of the weaker kiwi dollar.
Tranz Rail, which gained 10 cents to $9.00, reported an $11 million rise in annual net profit to $60.6 million after the close, although operating profit was flat at $73.2 million.
Brierley also enjoyed another strong day, up one at $1.41 on very heavy volume of 6.53 million shares.
Brokers said they knew of no specific reason for the large turnover, although one noted that talk of BIL selling its Air New Zealand 'B' shares popped up from time to time.
BIL's corporate debt rating was upgraded by Standard and Poor's to BBB from BBB- on Wednesday.
